title: Mekanism: Pumps
description: An unofficial addon for Mekanism that adds new types of pumps.
body:
### Adds new pump types:
### - Basic
### - Advanced
### - Elite
### - Ultimate
**Basic** = x3 Electric Pump **Advanced** = x5 Electric Pump **Elite** = x7 Electric Pump **Ultimate** = x9 Electric Pump

**Full support for improvements from the original Mekanism mod**
![pumps](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3753c71613fe4a54304e68f0d6cf7e9d918da62.png)

![contrast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec545f96a9803a2698b64a7f2c6913350be538e3.png)

**A well-balanced addon. Save space and enhance the beauty of your bases. Improve your gaming experience.**

We will be glad to receive feedback - feedback.mods.ceo44@outlook.com
